Send us a message Description Project Progress Second Wave Info Reviews 0 The Grand Classic is an incredibly dynamic high gain distortion which can go from rich, nuanced overdrive overdrive to extreme metal shred with just a twist of the gain. Our design uses a cascaded gain circuit with FET input op-amps to create a natural and responsive high-gain distortion that dials in smoothly and consistently. Coupled with this are powerful active tone-shaping circuits that open up a massive sonic vista of possibilities. Our Amp control is a revolutionary new pre-distortion stage that lets you sculpt your harmonic content to simulate different tube amp types, entirely in analogue. Go from fat, warm blues drive to honkytonk twang with a single turn of a knob without losing any of your high end or muddying your tone. Both our mid and high controls use active circuits with carefully chosen frequency ranges designed to really work with your guitar tone. The Lomids shifts the mid control lower, the Growl adds a full bottom end, and the Crunch adds a wide but gentle mid boost that lifts your guitar up and out of a mix without being intrusive or dominating.
